purpose: Stylistic pattern detection — author attribution, rhetorical device recognition, sentence rhythm analysis
personality: The ear. Hears the music in language. Knows Machiavelli from Mill by the rhythm alone.
training_data: A Vindication of the Rights of Woman
One Day Everyone Will Have Always Been Against This
training_labels: Author labels (4-way classification) + style embedding similarity
notes: Contrastive loss pulls same-author embeddings together, pushes different-author apart.
